title: Room: the harbour steps, now
purpose: harbour_steps (atlas H2), the present: the stone steps down to the harbour, the keeper's post and the customs house door. A playable room: the hero walks the lower third.

fields.setting: wide stone steps leading down to a ruined harbour at night, a customs house door on the right, a tide board on a post on the left
fields.composition: the steps fill the lower third and run left to right; the customs house door on the right edge; the harbour wall and a lamp post left of centre; masts dissolving into fog behind
fields.ground: broad worn flagstones, wet and reflective, kept open and clear of objects.
fields.light: a hazy moon behind the masts on the right

criteria: The lower third is open walkable floor with mid-to-light fog behind it.
The customs house door and the tide board read clearly as things to click.
No people, no readable text, no frame.
